title: [3.3] Adjusting "min_5m_carbimpact" setting have no effect on COB decay
body:
I noticed after going live with 3.3 that COB decay was faster (we use abit lower min_5m_carbimpact than default SMB setting) I tried setting it even lower but noticed it had no effect.

I think it's pretty straight forward to reproduce so I won't provide logs.

1) Add 60 Carbs 1-2 hours back in time.
2) Set min_5m_carbimpact = 8 and note COB
3) Set min_5m_carbimpact = 3 and note COB

Result is COB is unchanged and unaffected of min_5m_carbimpact 

I'm attaching some screenshots of this scenario in 3.3 and in 3.2 on my test-rig
